newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Amnesty raps Israel for administrative detentions.
newsitem.headline: Amnesty raps Israel for administrative detentions.

text.p: The human rights group Amnesty International criticised Israel on Wednesday for holding hundreds of Palestinians in jail without trial.

"The Israeli authorities should put an immediate stop to administrative detention...as their continuous misuse of this practice is in clear violation of fundamental human rights," the group said in a report.
It said some Palestinians had been jailed for years without trial and without being given details of the charges against them.
An Israeli army spokeswoman who received a two-page summary of the 20-page report said officials would have to review the full report before issuing a reaction.

Israel has defended administrative detention as a necessary measure in combatting Arab militants. Some Jews have also been jailed without trial including members of the banned extreme right-wing Kach group.

Amnesty said 270 detainees were being held under adminstrative detention at the beginning of this year. Detention orders of up to six months are frequently renewed without a judicial hearing, the report said.
